The roles of MSG Development Corp. and Vaxstar LLC remain unconfirmed due to absent details in the available filings.

findings.title: The divergence between Netcapital Inc.'s net income and operating cash flow is an innocent consequence of its equity cro
findings.description: The divergence between Netcapital Inc.'s net income and operating cash flow is an innocent consequence of its equity crowdfunding business model and standard GAAP compliance, where startup clients pay for consulting and portal services with equity instead of cash, which must be recognized as non-cash revenue and subsequently marked-to-market.
